skill.name: clojure-review
skill.description: Review Clojure and ClojureScript changes against Metabase style, module, API, test, database, and driver conventions.
skill.summary: Guides focused Metabase Clojure and ClojureScript code reviews.
skill.author: metabase

security_audit.summary: The Markdown backtick detections and the system-reconnaissance match are false positives from prose examples and review instructions. The parent-relative include references in SKILL.md are confirmed filesystem boundary risks because they load shared files from outside the skill directory.

remediation.suggestion: Package shared Clojure guidance inside the skill directory or use marketplace-supported includes that cannot escape the skill root.

static_findings.snippet: - If `CLOJURE_STYLE_GUIDE.adoc` exists in the working directory, also check compliance with the comm
- [ ] Public vars in `src` or `enterprise/backend/src` have useful docstrings
- [ ] `TODO` comments include author and date: `;; TODO (Name 2025-01-01) -- description`
- [ ] No `declare` when avoidable (public functions near end)
- [ ] No blank, non-comment lines within definition forms (except pairwise constructs in `let`/`cond
- [ ] Separate `deftest` forms for distinct test cases
- [ ] Query params use kebab-case, bodies use `snake_case`
- [ ] No raw MBQL manipulation outside `lib`, `lib-be`, or `query-processor` modules
- [ ] Uses `t2/select-one-fn` instead of selecting full rows for one column
- [ ] Passes `driver` argument to other driver methods (no hardcoded driver names)
- [ ] Kondo linter suppressions use proper format (not `#_:clj-kondo/ignore` keyword form)
| `;; TODO fix this`                           | Missing author/date: `;; TODO (Name 2025-01-01) --
| `(defn foo ...)` in namespace used elsewhere | Should be `(defn ^:private foo ...)`
| Query params with `snake_case`               | Use kebab-case for query params
> This pure function should be named as a noun describing its return value. Consider `user` instead
> This function is only used in this namespace, so it should be marked `^:private`.
> Query parameters should use kebab-case. Change `user_id` to `user-id`.
- Do not post comments confirming things "look good" or telling them they did something correctly

content.value_statement: Metabase Clojure reviews need consistent style and architecture checks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through focused standards-based feedback.
actual_capabilities: Reviews Clojure and ClojureScript diffs against Metabase style expectations.
Flags naming, docstring, TODO, privacy, and line-length issues.
Checks test structure, module namespace patterns, REST API conventions, and MBQL guidance.
Identifies database and driver review concerns listed in the checklist.
Produces concise review comments focused on violations and potential issues.
limitations: The guidance is specific to the Metabase codebase and may not fit other Clojure projects.
It depends on checklist review and does not replace compiler, linter, or test results.
It references shared files outside the skill directory, which may not be available in packaged installs.
It cannot prove runtime behavior without access to the changed code and project tools.

use_cases.title: Review Metabase Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Check Clojure and ClojureScript diffs for style, naming, tests, and architecture concerns before merge.

use_cases.title: Prepare Contributor Feedback
use_cases.description: Turn checklist violations into concise review comments that explain the requested change.

use_cases.title: Audit Backend API Changes
use_cases.description: Review new endpoints for response schemas, route naming, query parameters, side effects, and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Diff Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Metabase Clojure diff for style violations and potential issues. Only comment on items that need action.

prompt_templates.title: Focused Style Pass
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review for naming and organization.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this ClojureScript change for naming, docstrings, TODO format, private vars, function length, and test structure.

prompt_templates.title: API Convention Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Metabase API changes for namespace placement, schemas, route naming, parameter casing, side effects, and test coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Full Metabase Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pull request against Metabase Clojure standards, including modules, REST API, MBQL, database access, drivers, and reviewer comment quality.

output_examples.input: A pull request adds a Clojure helper with unclear naming and no docstring.
output_examples.output: The review flags the naming issue, requests a useful public docstring, and avoids positive comments for unchanged correct patterns.

output_examples.input: A backend API change adds a route with plural naming and missing tests.
output_examples.output: The review asks for singular route naming, confirms response schema expectations, and requests endpoint tests.

output_examples.input: A driver change adds new multimethod behavior without documentation.
output_examples.output: The review asks for driver changelog documentation and checks that driver arguments are passed through correctly.

best_practices: Provide the exact diff or files so the review can cite specific changes.
Run project linters and tests separately, then use this skill for human review guidance.
Ask for focused passes when reviewing large pull requests with API, database, or driver changes.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill as a general Clojure style guide for unrelated projects.
Do not ask it to praise correct code or produce approval-only review comments.
Do not rely on it to detect syntax errors that project tooling should catch.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews Metabase Clojure and ClojureScript changes for style, structure, API, database, test, and driver concerns.

faq.question: Does it run tests or linters?
faq.answer: No. It guides review comments and checklist checks. Run tests and linters separately in the project.

faq.question: Can it review non-Metabase Clojure code?
faq.answer: It can read other Clojure code, but its recommendations are tailored to Metabase standards.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Why does it avoid positive comments?
faq.answer: The skill instructs reviewers to post only actionable concerns, not comments that say code looks good.

faq.question: What should authors fix before publishing?
faq.answer: Move parent-relative shared file references inside the skill package or use a safe include mechanism.
